feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Temperatures drop to -6C with cold weather alert in force in some areas
articles.summary: Temperatures dropped below -6C overnight as parts of the country remain under a cold weather health alert.

articles.title: Jeffrey Donaldson's wife Eleanor placed on sex offenders' register after his rape conviction
articles.summary: Eleanor Donaldson, the wife of disgraced former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson, has been placed on the sex offenders' register.

articles.title: Mauricio Pochettino breaks down in tears during press conference
articles.summary: Mauricio Pochettino broke down in tears during a press conference as he discussed his decision to leave his US coaching role and take over at Manchester United.

articles.title: Mechanic offered 'special serum' to man who drugged and raped wife, court hears
articles.summary: A mechanic accused of plotting to drug and rape a man's wife offered a "special serum" to make her unconscious, a court has heard.

articles.title: Teenage girl who stabbed love rival to death pleads guilty to murder
articles.summary: A teenager who stabbed another girl to death during a pre-planned fight over a boy has pleaded guilty to murder.

articles.title: Two Iranians convicted of spying for their country after entering Britain illegally
articles.summary: Two Iranian nationals who arrived in the UK illegally have been found guilty of spying for their country in the first case of its kind.

articles.title: Former Hamas bodyguard unmasked after 'plotting terror attack' when given British citizenship
articles.summary: A former bodyguard to the leader of Hamas who was granted British citizenship before allegedly plotting a terrorist attack in Europe on the second anniversary of 7 October 2023 can be identified for the first time.
